coverage_gaps: No case verifies behaviour when an idempotency key already used for a refund is resubmitted with different request parameters (e.g. a different refund amount) against the same transaction; only the exact-duplicate replay case (TC-009) was covered.

No case verifies that a refund is still allowed to proceed when a transaction has an open/pending (not yet settled) chargeback dispute, which is the necessary contrast case to the settled-dispute denial in TC-007 and clarifies the boundary of BR-4.
